description: Source code implementing NEON-accelerated precoding functions for complex signal processing, including layer mapping, precoding, and conversion between data formats, specifically optimized for ARM NEON SIMD instructions.

classes.name: simd_cf_t
classes.description: Represents a set of complex numbers using NEON registers for real and imaginary parts.

methods.name: set1
methods.description: Sets the NEON registers with a complex constant.

methods.name: operator+
methods.description: Adds two interleaved complex float NEON register sets.

methods.name: operator*
methods.description: Multiplies NEON interleaved complex float set by a complex weight.

methods.name: add_mul
methods.description: Performs multiply-accumulate operation on NEON complex float sets.

methods.name: cf_to_cbf16
methods.description: Converts interleaved complex float NEON register set to 16-bit complex buffer format.

methods.name: apply_precoding_port
methods.description: Applies precoding weights to input RE buffer and outputs port-represented complex buffer.

methods.name: from_ci32_to_cf
methods.description: Converts 32-bit integer complex to float complex.

methods.name: from_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Converts 8-bit complex symbols to float complex NEON format.

methods.name: layer2_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Applies layer mapping for two layers and converts symbols to float complex.

methods.name: layer3_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Applies layer mapping for three layers and converts symbols to float complex.

methods.name: layer4_map_and_ci8_to_cf
methods.description: Applies layer mapping for four layers and converts symbols to float complex.

methods.name: template_apply_layer_map_and_precoding
methods.description: Template function applying layer mapping and precoding for N ports, optimized for different layer counts.

methods.name: apply_layer_map_and_precoding
methods.description: Public method invoking the template with maximum port count.
